literal: Good things all bad will become; even bad things good will become, wealth for making.
translation: In the endeavor to acquire wealth, all good efforts turn into harmful ones when fate is adverse, and even unfavorable things turn into beneficial ones when fate is favorable.
modern: செல்வத்தைச் சேர்க்கும் முயற்சியில், நல்லவை எல்லாம் தீமையாக மாறும்; தீமையானவைகளும் நன்மையாக மாறும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how fate completely alters the outcomes of one's efforts to acquire wealth. When fate is unfavorable, even the most well-planned, positive, and good actions turn into failures or cause harm. Conversely, when fate is favorable, even mistakes, obstacles, or seemingly bad circumstances turn around to produce successful and good results. Thus, the ultimate success in acquiring wealth depends not just on the nature of the actions themselves, but on the underlying power of fate.
